---
title: "NetFunrankR report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y, %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  result: NULL
  network: NULL
  alpha: 0.05
  code: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
    fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, dpi = 120)
library(NetFunrankR)
res <- params$result
alpha <- params$alpha
tab <- as.data.frame(res, alpha = alpha)
ev <- table(evidenceClass(res, alpha))
```

## Summary

- **Query genes in the network:** `r length(queryGenes(res))`
  (`r length(unmatchedGenes(res))` not found)
- **Network:** `r nfParams(res)$network`
- **Gene sets tested:** `r nrow(tab)`
- **Significant (FDR < `r alpha`):** `r sum(tab$fdr_combined < alpha)`
  (hypergeometric ORA: `r sum(tab$fdr_hyper < alpha)`)
- **Evidence classes:** overlap + network `r ev[["overlap + network"]]`,
  overlap only `r ev[["overlap only"]]`,
  network only `r ev[["network only"]]`, joint `r ev[["joint"]]`

## Evidence map

```{r evidence-map}
plotEvidenceMap(res, alpha = alpha)
```

## Top gene sets

```{r top-sets}
plotTopSets(res, n = 25, alpha = alpha)
```

## Significant gene sets

```{r table}
sig <- tab[tab$fdr_combined < alpha, c("set", "evidence", "overlap",
    "overlap_expected", "n_linker", "linker_expected", "p_overlap",
    "p_linker", "fdr_combined", "fdr_hyper", "linker_genes")]
for (p in c("p_overlap", "p_linker", "fdr_combined", "fdr_hyper"))
    sig[[p]] <- signif(sig[[p]], 2)
sig$overlap_expected <- round(sig$overlap_expected, 1)
sig$linker_expected <- round(sig$linker_expected, 1)
knitr::kable(sig, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Unmatched query genes

`r if (length(unmatchedGenes(res))) paste(unmatchedGenes(res), collapse = ", ") else "None."`

## Reproduce this analysis

```{r code, results = "asis"}
cat("```r\n", paste(params$code, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```
